provenance.note: The catchment OUTLET, as a Point: the pick's {coordinates, name} verbatim, a (lon, lat) pair, 'lat,lon' or a point layer (geocode a place name first) - the point the runoff drains to. It decides which basin is modelled at all, so it is asked for (picked on the canvas or passed explicitly) and NEVER invented. It is snapped onto the traced channel, so a click beside the stream still delineates its basin [supplied on this invocation]

Constant design-storm intensity, used when no measured series is given, in the engine's own unit - millimetres per DAY, so a 24 mm/h cloudburst is 576. A hypothetical storm, labeled as one. How long it rains for, and how wet the ground already is, are the deck's own keywords [supplied on this invocation]

Finest triangle edge, reached where the mesh refines toward the channel network. THE granularity lever: peak depth and flooded extent are resolution-bound classes and a coarse mesh reads both low [supplied on this invocation]

Apply the Huang (2006) steep-slope correction to the curve numbers using the mesh's own bed gradients. The engine's native branch is compiled off in the installed 9.0.0 build, so the correction is applied to the CN field before it is written [declared scenario default]
Coarsest triangle edge, reached far from the channels on the hillslopes [declared scenario default]
Solve sizing class - how many cores the solve is partitioned across. An engine that runs on one core says so on the card [declared constant default]

Vertical datum this run counts every elevation from - the bed under it and the level over it. A source published on another frame reaches this one through a measured offset, and a pair nobody publishes an offset between refuses by name [declared constant default]
not supplied; the constant design storm below drives the run, labeled as the hypothetical it is
not supplied; curve numbers are distributed PER NODE from the land-cover raster
not supplied; a surface is read at the most recent cycle its own source has published, and no series source is asked at all - a record is a reading at a time, and this run stated none
